title: Design: Inventory list and bulk bar fit a 1440 px wide window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a computer whose screen is set to 1440 pixels wide, with the browser window maximised and the page zoom at 100%.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 4.2 and 4.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title, the tabs and the toolbar each sit on their own line with nothing overlapping.
  • Every toolbar label reads in full: Search, Bin Location: All bin locations, Category: All categories, Supply, New Inventory Part.
  • Parts A and B are listed; columns that do not fit can be reached by scrolling the table sideways, and no header text overlaps another.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens below the three-dot button and every entry reads in full.

Step 3:

  • The dark bar fits the list's width on its own line under the tabs, with the badge, "selected", the divider, the Deactivate button and the X all showing.
  • The search and filter row under the bar keeps every label in full.

Step 4:

  • Part A is ticked and the badge reads 1.

Step 5:

  • The badge reads 2 and "2 records selected." shows under the table without overlapping the rows.

Step 6:

  • The dark bar and the checkboxes disappear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • Feature Overview, Form factor: “Parts management (the Inventory list, the part dialog and the bulk bar) is desktop and tablet. No phone layout is provided for it.”
  • S1-R8: “The Active and Inactive tabs sit on their own line under the page title, above the search and filter row.”
  • S2-R7: “While the mode is on, the bulk bar spans the full width of the list directly under the Active and Inactive tabs, and the search and filter row moves down under it.”
